name: encore-karaoke
description: Stateless karaoke rooms with one main browser screen and code/QR phone controllers.

scripts.build: npm run build:server && npm run test:web-types && node build-server.mjs
scripts.dev: npm run build && tsx watch server/index.ts
scripts.test: npm run lint && npm run test:server
scripts.test:server: npm run build:server && node --import tsx --test tests/server/*.test.mjs
scripts.test:container: docker buildx build --platform linux/amd64 --output type=cacheonly -f deploy/Dockerfile .
scripts.lint: eslint server shared src/hosted src/platform tests/server build-server.mjs eslint.config.js

author: Encore Karaoke Labs
